text: [L38-L55,L65-L83] (HIGH/rank-to-decomposition off-by-one) For source rank `i-1` the root uses decomposition entry `i-1`, and rank `ra` sends dimensions from entry `ra`; this conflicts with the shard's distribution template mapping rank `r` to entry `r+1`, so gathered blocks can use the preceding rank's extents, offsets, and boundary flags.
